ground_truth.rationale: EV-GPS-00301 trace_distance_km is 16.50 against an optimal of 14.2 km on EV-TRIP-00301, an excess of 2.30 km or 16.2%. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess exceeds BOTH 20% AND 0.8 km; the absolute test passes but the percentage test fails, so no deviation exists. The rider's claim_text is long and confident but names no evidence, and POL-RD-08 gives it no weight. All six singleton artifacts are COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and EV-ADVIS-00301-01 is MISSING, which is neutral. Outcome NO_ACTION; the charge on EV-FARE-00301 stands.

EV-GPS-00302 trace_distance_km 28.20 km against optimal 22.0 km on EV-TRIP-00302: excess 6.20 km, 28.2%, which passes both POL-RD-01 limbs and is not MATERIAL (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged. No advisory exists (EV-ADVIS-00302-01 MISSING) and the chat is empty, so nothing under POL-RD-03/04/05 excuses the excess. EV-FARE-00302 is METERED with surge_multiplier 1.2, read from the fare artifact as POL-RD-02 requires. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75x22.0 + 0.28x28.0) x 1.2) + 0.80 + 1.50 on-route BKE gantry = 36.068; charged_total 48.34; refund 12.272 rounded up to 12.30. The two CTE gantries (2.00 + 1.00) are off the optimal route and are ALREADY inside that figure under POL-RD-09(1); adding them again would wrongly produce 15.30. PARTIAL_REFUND 12.30.

The driver's counterparty_statement is precise and reads persuasively but it cites the wrong field. POL-RD-01 states that gps_trace.trace_distance_km governs and trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded copy that may NOT be cited for the threshold test. EV-GPS-00303 trace_distance_km is 11.43 km: excess 1.93 km, 20.32%, which is greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km, so a deviation IS established. On the rounded EV-TRIP-00303 figure of 11.4 km the excess is exactly 20.0%, which would fail the strict inequality, and that is the trap. No exculpatory artifact exists. POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare 15.365, charged_total 18.05, refund 2.685 rounded up to 2.70, above the 0.50 de minimis. PARTIAL_REFUND 2.70.

EV-GPS-00304 trace 28.90 km vs optimal 24.0 km: excess 4.90 km (20.4%), established under POL-RD-01. EV-ADVIS-00304-01 is a COMPLETE LTA_DATAMALL CLOSURE on the PIE segment the optimal route traverses, intersects_route true, overlaps the trip window by 41.0 min, and the trace leaves the PIE corridor before Eunos and rejoins toward Changi, so POL-RD-03(a)(b)(c) are met. Cap = min(excess, 1.30 x (27.5 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(4.90, 5.55) = 4.90: the whole excess is justified and no residual deviation survives, so POL-RD-02 issues nothing on distance or time. But POL-RD-09(2) is explicit: where the deviation is exonerated under POL-RD-03, off-route ERP is still refunded to the rider standalone. EV-FARE-00304 carries one ECP gantry, 1.00, on_optimal_route false. PARTIAL_REFUND 1.00. A Judge that runs POL-RD-02 here over-refunds; one that stops at exoneration under-refunds.

The claim_text reads as a straightforward detour complaint, but EV-CHAT-00305 MSG-00305-001 is a rider instruction 40 s after started_at, before the vehicle left the corridor, naming Pasir Ris MRT with a populated waypoint_hint; EV-GPS-00305 passes within 5 m of that coordinate, so POL-RD-04(a)(b)(c) are met and the trace corroborates. The trip decomposes into two legs: Tampines Hub to Pasir Ris MRT, 2.38 km traced against a corridor estimate of about 2.73 km, and Pasir Ris MRT to Paya Lebar Square, 8.81 km against about 10.13 km; neither leg carries an excess meeting POL-RD-01, so once the rider-requested stop is excluded no deviation exists against the booked 7.6 km optimal and no refund is due. Separately, EV-FARE-00305 distance_charged_km is 9.5 against a trace of 11.18 km, a shortfall of 1.70 km exceeding 1.0 km; POL-RD-04's compensation limb pays 0.75 per unbilled km rounded UP to 0.05: 1.2750 -> 1.30, under the 15.00 cap. DRIVER_COMPENSATION 1.30; per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd mirrors it and the rider's charge stands.

EV-GPS-00306 trace 33.48 km vs optimal 21.0 km: excess 12.48 km, 59.4%, established and MATERIAL under POL-RD-01 (over 50% and over 8.0 km). The driver's roadblock assertion is unsupported by any advisory (EV-ADVIS-00306-01 MISSING) and POL-RD-08 discards it. POL-RD-06 requires the driver_profile check on a material deviation: EV-DPROF-00306 deviation_flags_90d is 3, meeting the count limb; prior_deviation_flags of 7 is the lifetime counter and is not the field the clause reads, though here both point the same way. Pattern established. Limb (b): the deviation is material AND substantiated on this trip's own trace, so FULL_REFUND of charged_total is licensed in place of the POL-RD-02 partial; POL-RD-02 would give charged_total 42.05 minus recomputed 27.910 = 14.15, and the uplifted figure is 42.05; both are stated so the uplift is auditable. No pass-through lines exist to carve out under POL-RD-09. Limb (c) refers the driver to conduct review, a REFERRAL not an escalation, so money still moves. amount_contested equals charged_total. FULL_REFUND 42.05.

EV-GPS-00307 is IMPAIRED: a single 240 s gap in the KPE tunnel, which is the very segment the rider disputes, with coverage 86.7% and schema weight 0.39. The gap exceeds 90 s, so the trace is impaired FOR POLICY PURPOSES under POL-RD-07(a), not merely schema-impaired. Under POL-RD-07(i) the excess across the gap is the straight line between the bounding fixes, and under (ii) a deviation may not be established on this trace alone. No independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists: EV-CHAT-00307 is empty, EV-FARE-00307 carries no ERP, the counterparty_statement denies the route, and EV-TRIP-00307 actual_distance_km is the rounded copy of this same trace. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) therefore require ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION: the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at weight 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which independently triggers POL-RD-10(1). The reviewer should seek the KPE gantry or tunnel-camera record for the gap window.

EV-GPS-00308 trace 12.20 km vs optimal 9.0 km is an excess of 35.6%, so a deviation is established under POL-RD-01 but is not MATERIAL, and POL-RD-06 is not engaged. EV-FARE-00308 fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 15.27 equal to total_charged; POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does NOT run. The rider's remedies under POL-RD-11 are (a) any excess of charged_total over the quote plus properly chargeable pass-through lines, which is zero, and (b) a POL-RD-09 correction for off-route or phantom lines, of which there are none (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00). The rider is already whole on distance and time; the loss of the extra 3.20 km falls on the driver. The long claim_text carries no evidence ID and POL-RD-08 gives it no weight. NO_ACTION.

EV-TRIP-00309 vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 applies: the POL-RD-01 baseline is the MATCHED-ITINERARY optimal_distance_km of 19.4 km, not solo_optimal_distance_km of 15.2 km, which is carried for reference only. EV-GPS-00309 trace 20.30 km: excess over the matched figure is 0.90 km, 4.6%, failing the 20% limb; no deviation. Measured against the solo figure the excess would be 33.6%, and a claim built on that has cited the wrong field and fails on that ground alone. The Hougang detour is the platform-matched co-rider pickup, confirmed by MSG-00309-001, and is excluded from excess by POL-RD-12 before POL-RD-01 runs. NO_ACTION.

Two separate questions. First, deviation: EV-GPS-00310 trace 13.70 km vs optimal 13.0 km is 5.4%, failing POL-RD-01's 20% limb, so no deviation and no POL-RD-02 refund; the rider's 'longer way' assertion is not made out. Second, billing integrity under POL-RD-09(4): EV-FARE-00310 itemises a CTE Braddell gantry at 3.00 with coordinates 1.341800, 103.848900; no fix in EV-GPS-00310 lies within 250 m of that point at any time, so the line is a phantom and is refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists. The ECP Fort Rd gantry at 2.00 is matched to the trace and on the optimal route, and stands. The 2.00 promo_discount is unaffected. The phantom line is recorded as a billing-integrity referral; POL-RD-10(8) is not triggered because the only unmatched line is the one refunded here. PARTIAL_REFUND 3.00 of the 8.00 contested.

Re-derived under policy version 6 (POL-RD-14, amendment 0002). EV-CHAT-00311 MSG-00311-001 is a rider instruction naming Clementi Mall with a populated waypoint_hint, 50 s after started_at, so it meets POL-RD-04(a) to (c) on its face; but the nearest fix on EV-GPS-00311 is 2595 m from that waypoint, far outside 200 m, so the trace never corroborates it. POL-RD-14 decides exactly this: the instruction did not cause the measured excess, POL-RD-04 does not apply, no distance is excluded, and this is not the POL-RD-10(7) contradiction, which is engaged only where the trace corroborates the instruction in part. The driver's statement that the rider then cancelled the stop cites no evidence ID and has no chat support, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight. POL-RD-01 on the trace as measured: 12.40 km against the booked 7.5 km, excess 4.90 km or 65.3 percent, established and MATERIAL; POL-RD-06 is consulted and EV-DPROF-00311.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 260 completed trips, so no pattern. POL-RD-02 on the booked optimal (7.5 km, 12.0 min, surge 1.0, no ERP): recomputed fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.5 + 0.28 x 12.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 13.585; refund = charged_total 20.62 - 13.585 = 7.035, rounded up to 7.05, 34 percent of charged_total, so PARTIAL_REFUND. The figure exceeds the rider's amount_contested 5.00: POL-RD-02 states the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary, and the development keys follow the same reading. It is below execution_threshold_sgd 8.00, so POL-GEN-05 does not hold it. PARTIAL_REFUND 7.05.

EV-TRIP-00312 dropoff_amended_at is non-null and amended_optimal_distance_km is 14.0 km, so POL-RD-05 re-applies POL-RD-01 against the AMENDED endpoints and that stored figure, not the booked 12.5 km. EV-GPS-00312 trace 17.57 km: excess 3.57 km, 25.5%, established and not material. EV-RPROF-00312 shows deviation_claims_60d 5 with 0 substantiated, so POL-RD-08 raises the bar: an excess below 30% needs corroboration beyond the gps_trace. That corroboration exists in EV-CHAT-00312 MSG-00312-003, a driver admission of missing the Braddell exit, one of the sources POL-RD-07(ii) names. POL-RD-08 states the profile factor may never deny a claim otherwise proven, and POL-GEN-01 makes the driver's invitation to 'check her record' a discarded ground. POL-RD-02 against the amended optimal: recomputed 20.420, charged_total 24.52, refund 4.100 rounded up to 4.10. PARTIAL_REFUND 4.10.

EV-TRIP-00401 records arrived_at, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW by the driver, pickup_zone_class AIRPORT and vehicle RYDE_PLUS; fee_schedule gives max(6.00 airport, 6.00 plus) = 6.00, reconciling with EV-FARE-00401 so POL-NS-08(d) is clean. EV-GPS-00401 shows the driver stationary within the 150 m airport radius with sub-25 m accuracy from the first qualifying fix at 21:20:00 through cancellation, a dwell of 490 s, above the 480 s AIRPORT minimum in POL-NS-01(c); limbs (a)-(d) all hold. EV-CHAT-00401 carries two driver messages delivered and read and a VOICE_CALL_LOG line, mirrored by trip_record.in_app_calls, so POL-NS-04(b) cannot be met; and rider_track places the rider's device about 1206 m away throughout, so POL-NS-04(c) fails affirmatively. The rider's long claim_text is sympathetic but names no evidence. POL-NS-07: EV-DPROF-00401 no_show_terminations_30d 1 of 120 completed, no farming pattern. DRIVER_COMPENSATION 4.80 (80% of 6.00); amount_sgd mirrors it and the fee stands.

The driver's statement is precise and confident, but EV-GPS-00402 at the arrived_at timestamp (07:41:40) places the vehicle about 740 m from the pin travelling at 18.3 km/h: both POL-NS-05 triggers fire (over 300 m, at or above 15 km/h), so the arrival marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock. The clock is recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix under POL-NS-02, which is at 07:45:10; from there to cancellation is 210 s, short of the 300 s STANDARD minimum. POL-NS-05(i) applies: full refund, no driver compensation. POL-NS-01(c) fails on the same arithmetic. EV-FARE-00402 cancellation_fee 4.00 reconciles with the schedule. The rider's own presence (rider_track within 100 m) is not required for this outcome. FULL_REFUND 4.00.

EV-TRIP-00403 pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE gives a 120 m arrival radius under POL-NS-02. EV-GPS-00403 shows the driver stationary for about 350 s at a point roughly 260 m from the pin: outside the radius, inside 400 m, with gps_point.venue_id VEN-WESTGATE matching trip_record.pickup.venue_id, so POL-NS-03 governs and confirms a wrong-face-of-the-same-venue case. cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission and cannot satisfy POL-NS-01(d). The fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full. Fault for compensation: EV-CHAT-00403 MSG-00403-002 is the rider naming the exact sub-location, and the trace shows the driver never moved; POL-NS-03(i) applies and no compensation is payable. The driver did reply within 120 s so POL-NS-04 is not engaged. FULL_REFUND 4.00.

EV-GPS-00404 places the driver stationary about 295 m from the pin for roughly 330 s, outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius and inside 400 m, with venue_id VEN-BAYSHORE-PARK on both the fixes and the pin, so POL-NS-03 governs: POL-NS-01(b) fails and the fee is refunded in full. Fault allocation from EV-CHAT-00404: 'arrived', 'coming', '?' - neither party specified a guardhouse, and EV-TRIP-00404 registered_pickup_points is 2, so POL-NS-03(ii) attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity and pays the driver a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50% of the fee, 2.00, never recovered from the rider. Per POL-GEN-03 the two figures are independent and both fields are populated; the ruling value names the FILING party's outcome. FULL_REFUND 4.00 with driver_compensation_sgd 2.00.

EV-GPS-00405 shows the driver correctly inside the 50 m STANDARD radius with a dwell of 320 s from the first qualifying fix at 09:10:45, so POL-NS-01(a)-(d) are satisfied on their own terms. But POL-NS-04 displaces them: (a) EV-CHAT-00405 MSG-00405-002 is a rider message in the waiting window stating her position and asking the driver's, delivered and read; (b) the driver posted no reply within 120 s or at all, and EV-TRIP-00405 in_app_calls is empty; (c) rider_track places the rider's device within the 100 m presence radius with sub-25 m accuracy for the majority of fixes. All three limbs hold, the rider is exonerated, and no driver compensation is payable. FULL_REFUND 4.00.

The rider's message (MSG-00406-002) and presence would satisfy POL-NS-04(a) and (c), but limb (b) requires that the driver NEITHER replied in chat within 120 s NOR placed an in-app voice call before terminating. EV-TRIP-00406 in_app_calls records a DRIVER call at 09:10:45+90 s, 18 s, unanswered, mirrored by the VOICE_CALL_LOG line MSG-00406-003; POL-NS-04's own notes say this defeats the clause even where the chat shows nothing. POL-NS-04 does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01: arrived, in-radius with sub-25 m fixes, dwell 320 s over the 300 s minimum, RIDER_NO_SHOW by the driver. Anti-farming under POL-NS-07 is clean (no_show_terminations_30d 1). DRIVER_COMPENSATION 3.20; the rider's fee stands. A Judge that reads only the chat and misses trip_record.in_app_calls reverses this case.

EV-TRIP-00407 pickup_zone_class TRANSPORT_HUB and vehicle RYDE_X: fee_schedule gives max(6.00 hub, 4.00 tier) = 6.00, matching EV-FARE-00407. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 s measured from the first qualifying fix. EV-GPS-00407: first qualifying in-radius fix at 17:02:20, cancellation at 17:07:18, dwell 298 s, a 2 s shortfall. POL-NS-06 is strict liability: the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present, and rider_track showing the rider about 900 m away does not change that. No advisory supports POL-NS-06(i) interval summing. FULL_REFUND 6.00, no compensation.

This dispute is filed by the DRIVER over a fee EV-FARE-00408 shows as payment_status REFUNDED with refund_issued_sgd 4.00. The question is whether the driver's claim that the fee was properly chargeable is made out. EV-GPS-00408: first qualifying in-radius fix at 06:54:40, cancellation at 06:58:40, dwell 240 s, 60 s short of the STANDARD minimum. POL-NS-01(c) fails and POL-NS-06 says the fee is not chargeable. The driver's claim is therefore not supported. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION is PARTY-RELATIVE: the filing party did not make out their claim and the present state stands, which here means the rider remains refunded. A literal reading of POL-NS-06's 'refunded in full' would emit FULL_REFUND, but the fee has already been reversed and the filing party is the driver; the correct value is NO_ACTION with amount null. EV-CHAT-00408 is IMPAIRED (UNREAD_MESSAGE, weight 0.85) but the deciding fact rests on the trace and trip record at weight 1.0, so confidence is uncapped.

expected_referrals: POL-NS-07 instruction: refund the rider's cancellation fee in full
ground_truth.rationale: On this trip's evidence POL-NS-01 is satisfied: EV-GPS-00409 in-radius dwell 330 s with sub-25 m fixes, EV-TRIP-00409 RIDER_NO_SHOW by the driver, a message and an unanswered call, rider_track about 640 m away. POL-NS-07 would then pay the driver 3.20, but it is subject to the anti-farming check on the exact fields it names: EV-DPROF-00409 no_show_terminations_30d is 5 (at least 4) and 5 / completed_trips_30d 40 = 0.125, greater than 0.08. Both limbs trip. prior_no_show_flags is 1, but that is the lifetime counter, is NOT the field POL-NS-07 or POL-NS-09(d) reads, and reading it instead would miss the pattern. Compensation is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d); the fee is held rather than collected or refunded, and the escalation packet must carry POL-NS-07's instruction directing the reviewer to refund the rider's fee in full. ESCALATE, amount null, with that referral recorded.

EV-TRIP-00410 records arrived_at 09:10:00 and cancelled_at 09:16:30, a 6.5 min dwell at the pin. EV-GPS-00410, COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 5-11 m accuracy, places the driver stationary about 850 m from the pin for that entire interval, outside the 50 m radius, outside 300 m (so not POL-NS-05's false-marker case, which concerns a moving driver) and outside 400 m (so not POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance case). Two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves the conflict; the trip record is tagged CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT at weight 0.40, but the conflict itself is the finding. This is POL-NS-09(b) in terms. The tribunal declines to pick a side: ESCALATE, fee held. The reviewer should obtain the driver's device log or the platform's arrival-marker source to determine which record is corrupt.

EV-GPS-00411 is MISSING at weight 0.0. Every clause that could decide this case - POL-NS-01(b)(c), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06 - requires the gps_trace, and POL-GEN-02 states a MISSING artifact can carry no fact; its absence is citable, its contents are not. The only evidence of the driver's presence is EV-TRIP-00411 arrived_at, which is the driver's own tap, and EV-CHAT-00411, which records both parties asserting positions the record cannot verify. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the deciding fact rests solely on an artifact at weight 0.0, so confidence is capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation. Neither party's account is preferred: the fee is neither chargeable nor refundable on this record. ESCALATE with the fee held; the reviewer should seek the driver's device-side location history or any venue CCTV for the window.

EV-RPROF-00412 shows a poor lifetime record (rating 3.82, 9 disputes filed, 6 prior_no_show_flags) and EV-DPROF-00412 an exemplary one, and the driver's statement invites the tribunal to decide on that basis. POL-GEN-01 forbids it: every one of those fields is CONTEXT ONLY, and the only citable rider counter, no_show_disputes_30d, is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3. The case is decided on this trip's evidence. EV-GPS-00412: first qualifying in-radius fix at 12:45:20, cancellation at 12:48:40, dwell 200 s, 100 s short of the STANDARD minimum. POL-NS-01(c) fails and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full regardless of the rider's response. rider_track incidentally places the rider within 100 m. FULL_REFUND 4.00, no compensation. A Judge that weights the profiles reverses this case.
